answer: Forging identities costs real capital at every horizon, since a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds, and the atlas ledger slashes any cluster sharing attestation graphs. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays over epochs, and peers attest only to agents whose bond exceeds a rolling median tracked in the cedar registry. Attackers thus pay linearly to scale while legitimate agents recover stake on exit. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
